title: Halloween Word Search
subtitle: Large Print: 60 Spooky Fun Puzzles for Adults & Seniors
author: Hollow Pine Puzzles
description:
A treat for puzzle lovers.

Skip the tricks and enjoy the treats with 60 large print word search puzzles packed with Halloween fun. From jack-o-lanterns and black cats to haunted houses, harvest suppers and old folklore, every puzzle celebrates the spookiest season of the year. Spooky, never gory.

Inside you'll find:

  • 60 themed puzzles: costumes, candy, witches, monsters, pumpkin patches, autumn and more
  • Large, bold letters on big 8.5 x 11 inch pages that are easy on the eyes
  • Words run forward and diagonally only, never backwards
  • One puzzle per page, with every answer at the back

A fun October gift for grandparents, parents and puzzle fans, and a perfect non-candy treat for the Halloween season.
